DevOps Engineer, Node Infrastructure
Helix Protocol — Berlin / Remote

About Helix
Helix Protocol builds validator and staking infrastructure for Ethereum and Cosmos. We run a fleet of validator nodes and public RPC endpoints for institutional staking providers. Our team values ownership and a hands-on go-to-market mindset; we are an R&D-driven, C-suite-led company.

Responsibilities
- Automate validator and archive node deployments with Terraform, Ansible and Helm.
- Operate Kubernetes clusters on AWS and GCP; manage Helm charts and Argo CD GitOps pipelines.
- Build and maintain GitLab CI pipelines, Docker images and release automation.
- Run Linux hardening, DNS, load balancing, Nginx and Envoy at the edge.
- Operate Postgres, Redis, Kafka and ClickHouse for chain data and indexers.
- Maintain observability with Prometheus, Grafana and Datadog; own SLOs and capacity planning.
- Implement IAM, Vault, KMS, HSM and key management controls for validator keys.
- Support SOC 2 and ISO 27001 audits, disaster recovery and multi-region failover.
- Ship subgraphs and block explorers for on-chain analytics.

任职要求：
- 5 年以上 DevOps / 平台工程经验
- 精通 Kubernetes 容器编排 与 Helm
- 熟悉 Terraform、Ansible 等基础设施即代码工具
- 有节点运维经验（Ethereum 执行客户端 / 信标链 / 归档节点）
- 熟悉可观测性体系（Prometheus、Grafana、OpenTelemetry）
- 熟悉云平台（AWS / GCP）与 Linux 网络
- 熟悉 Vault、IAM、KMS 等密钥与访问管理
- 有金融/加密行业合规经验（SOC 2、ISO 27001、KYC/AML）

加分项：
- 质押（staking）与验证者（validator）运维
- 低延迟交易系统、撮合引擎
- Rust 或 Go 开发经验

Benefits
- Relocation support to Berlin, remote-friendly setup and a hardware budget
- Regular team offsites and a yearly protocol retreat
- Equity in the protocol treasury
